subject: general
question: In 2021, the Indian men's cricket team defeated Australia at the Gabba stadium in a Test match becoming the only cricket team to defeat Australia in Brisbane since __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1988.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** correct answer** is **option 4, i.e. 1988,** as India became the **first team to beat Australia **at the** Gabba** since the West Indies in **1988.**
 
• The Indian cricket team's victory at Gabba in **2021** is considered historic as Australia had not lost a Test match at the Gabba since 1988.
 
• The other options given in the question are **not correct **as Australia had lost Test matches in Brisbane before **1996, 1992, and 1990.**
 
• The West Indies team was the last team to **beat Australia at the Gabba **before India, in the year **1988.**
 
• The Indian cricket team's victory at Gabba in 2021 was also significant as they were playing without their** regular captain** and several key players due to **injuries.**
 
• Hence, the statement in the question is** correct**, and India became the **only cricket team to defeat** Australia in Brisbane since 1988.
